HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Entity choice for KitchenGrid: note to Richard Roe
We compared a Colorado LLC with a Delaware corporation for the kitchen scheduling
business.
A Colorado LLC costs $125 to form and has no franchise tax. Pass-through tax
treatment lets each of us use early losses on our own returns.
A Delaware corporation is what venture funds usually ask for, because preferred
stock and option plans are simple to set up there.
Decision: we form Harbor Labs as a Colorado LLC now and convert to a Delaware
corporation before any priced round.
We expect to be talking to seed funds by May 2011, so the conversion is budgeted at
$3,400 in outside costs.
We have two members, no employees and no outside money today.
